comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I actually think it goes well into Order of the Prince with its data updates. At least to chapter 1 due to the presence of Sagres -- with chapter 2 still a work in progress, given Mangalore (Mangalore) and Inhambane (Inhambane).

Possibly the updates go as far as chapter 3, with Damascus Swords (Damascus Sword) present... interesting. Very interesting. And then there are the "mystery spots" in the DB like Haiphong ... but I digress. Thanks indeed, enigmatically silent operators, for even if there's obviously still a long way to go, it's nice to see you still care to update the data here, from time to time. Cheers.

Oh, right. About this discovery? It's located in Cape Town (or Cape, if you prefer). Enter the port, and with R10 Recognition skill, it can be found during rainy weather. Not sure if the time of "year" in-game counts or not.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=5869
